title: Pre-ready facade calls queue behind facadeReady; sink events emit in causal per-operation order
asA: developer wiring domain code that may issue a get or put before the facade ready-check has resolved
iWant: the facade to queue pre-ready calls and drain them in issue-order after ready() resolves, and to emit sink events in the same order the operations completed
soThat: no vendor put/get lands on an unbound binding, and a downstream logging companion observes a causal per-key event ordering

acceptanceCriteria.description: Two facade.get calls issued BEFORE ready() has resolved settle in issue order after ready() completes. Neither returns a vendor error; both fire kvMiss (empty store) in issue order; a facadeReady event fires before both kvMiss records on the sink.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade instantiated with an in-memory KV driver whose ready-check is artificially delayed by 25ms
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.get("a") and facade.get("b") are called synchronously before ready() has resolved
acceptanceCriteria.then: the calls settle after ready() completes, both return no-value results with source origin, and the sink shows facadeReady, kvMiss("a"), kvMiss("b") in that order

acceptanceCriteria.description: A pre-ready call whose subsequent ready-check throws is rejected with a named error kind (KV_FACADE_NOT_READY) and no sink record is emitted for that call; a subsequent successful facade re-instantiation opens cleanly and the queue does not leak across instances.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade instantiated with a KV driver whose list(limit:1) ready-check throws
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.get("a") is called before ready() has resolved
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call rejects with KV_FACADE_NOT_READY and no sink record is emitted for the failed call

acceptanceCriteria.description: Two facade.put calls issued in order on the same key emit kvWrite records in the same issue order on the sink; interleaved put and get calls on the same key emit kvWrite/kvHit records in the exact interleaving observed on the driver.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade instantiated with an in-memory KV driver and a ready() completed
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.put(k, v1), facade.put(k, v2) and facade.get(k) are called in that order
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink observes kvWrite(k, v1), kvWrite(k, v2), kvHit(k, v2) in issue order
